checks.scope: Conditional sensitivity checks on shared data, not independent confirmation or a joint confidence interval
checks.calibration_caution: Our saved synthetic study found false positives above the nominal level for ordinary and adjusted intervals in dependent records. Nominal 95% intervals are not guaranteed to achieve 95% coverage for a real location. See evaluation/results.json for the protocol-specific rates.

settings.hac_critical_distribution: Student t with n-2 degrees of freedom
settings.theil_sen: Median of pairwise slopes; slope only, no dependence-adjusted interval
settings.period_checks: Full period; omit first 5 calendar years; omit last 5; omit both ends
settings.interpretation: Conditional sensitivity checks on shared data, not independent confirmation or a joint confidence interval

header.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Monthly and Annual

provenance.payload_hash_format: SHA256 of Python sorted-key compact JSON after converting integral floats to integers, including negative zero

spatial_resolution.description: Native MERRA-2 meteorology grid: 0.5° latitude × 0.625° longitude. Requested coordinates do not imply street-level precision.

method: OLS annual estimate and independent-error mean band. Newey-West conditional intervals, Theil-Sen slope, one-year influence, and fixed period checks. All settings, raw data, hashes, and versions are included. These checks do not guarantee calibrated real-data coverage or adjust for multiple exploration.
built_from: Climate Explorer prototype started 2026-11-11; competition eligibility not established.
